query: UPDATE series SET description = COALESCE($2, description), cover_url = COALESCE($3, cover_url), content_type = CASE WHEN content_type = 'unknown' THEN COALESCE($4::text::content_type, content_type) ELSE content_type END, release_year = COALESCE(release_year, $5), updated_at = now() WHERE id = $1
